name: Steve Kelly
bio: Steve Kelly founded Maine Dispensary Guide in 2021 after four years operating a medical caregiver practice in southern Maine. He holds a Maine Cannabis Cultivation Registration and spent 2020-2022 collaborating with the Office of Cannabis Policy on caregiver-to-licensee transition documentation. His founder-level focus: regulatory mapping, the municipal opt-in landscape, and making complex Title 28-B mechanics legible to first-time operators.
credentials: OCP public-comment contributor on caregiver-to-licensee transition (2021-2022)
Primary-source analyst for Maine municipal opt-in ordinance reviews
Editor, Maine Dispensary Guide corrections log (since 2022)
knowsAbout: Municipal opt-in landscape across all 500+ Maine towns
Operator strategy and licensing timeline planning
description: Steve Kelly is the founder and publisher of Maine Dispensary Guide. He has covered Maine's cannabis operator landscape since the caregiver-era rollout, with particular focus on the Maine OCP's transition to a tier-license framework, municipal opt-in mechanics, and the operational challenges of cannabis operators in small-town Maine. Steve's primary editorial role on this site is regulatory mapping and licensing strategy — translating Title 28-B statutes and OCP rulemakings into operator-actionable guidance.

name: Calvin Waters
bio: Calvin Waters covers Maine OCP licensing, municipal authorization, and regulatory compliance for Maine Dispensary Guide. His work focuses on the procedural mechanics of getting a cannabis business licensed and maintaining compliance once operational.
credentials: Primary reviewer on Maine Dispensary Guide compliance guides
Editor, Maine Dispensary Guide corrections log
knowsAbout: License denial grounds and appeal mechanisms
description: Calvin Waters covers Maine OCP licensing, municipal authorization, and regulatory compliance for Maine Dispensary Guide. His work focuses on the procedural mechanics of getting a cannabis business licensed under Title 28-B and the conditional-license landscape across Maine's opting-in municipalities. Calvin has reviewed more than 200 OCP license applications as a third-party consultant and previously worked in compliance at a Portland-area cultivation facility. He is the primary reviewer on Maine Dispensary Guide's compliance-tagged guides and the lead editor on the site's corrections log.

name: Margaret Finch
bio: Margaret Finch covers 280E tax strategy, dispensary economics, and financial planning for Maine cannabis operators. She specializes in helping operators understand the real cost of compliance and profitability in the Maine market.
credentials: Reviews all dollar-figure claims against operator sources
knowsAbout: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) optimization under 280E
description: Margaret Finch covers 280E tax strategy, dispensary economics, and financial planning for Maine cannabis operators. Her work focuses on helping operators understand the real cost of compliance and profit under Maine's 14% retail tax and IRC §280E federal restrictions. Margaret's coverage draws from operator interviews, financial benchmarking against NAIC and IRS data, and her background in cannabis-focused accounting. She holds a Maine Cannabis Operations Endorsement and reviews every dollar-figure claim on Maine Dispensary Guide against operator-disclosed sources.

name: Eliot Nash
bio: Eliot Nash covers Maine cannabis market analysis, municipal zoning, and site selection for Maine Dispensary Guide. His work focuses on the geographic and competitive landscape of Maine's cannabis market.
credentials: Built Maine Dispensary Guide's market-data dashboard
Visited 140+ Maine dispensaries for on-site observation
Municipal-zoning mapping across 30+ opted-in Maine towns
Dispensary-density ratio analyst per NAIC + state data
knowsAbout: Municipal zoning across all opted-in Maine towns
Underserved-market analysis per NAIC + state data
Route 1 / Route 302 / I-95 corridor operator reports
description: Eliot Nash covers Maine cannabis market analysis, municipal zoning, and site selection for Maine Dispensary Guide. His work focuses on the geographic and competitive landscape of Maine's cannabis market — including underserved-county analyses, dispensary-density ratios, and traffic-count thresholds for viable retail locations. Eliot built the operator-facing market-data dashboard used on this site and has personally visited more than 140 Maine dispensaries while gathering on-site observation data for the guide pages.

name: Thalia Greene
bio: Thalia Greene reviews Maine Dispensary Guide's home cultivation and plant-care content. Her work focuses on translating horticultural practice and strain genetics into practical, climate-appropriate advice for Maine's home growers.
credentials: 10+ years of indoor/outdoor cultivation experience (central Maine)
Reviews all consumer-side guides for scientific accuracy
description: Thalia Greene reviews Maine Dispensary Guide's home cultivation and cannabis-science content. Her work focuses on translating horticultural practice, cannabinoid and terpene pharmacology, and strain genetics into practical, Maine-climate-appropriate guidance for home growers. Thalia draws on a decade of indoor and outdoor cultivation experience in central Maine and reviews every consumer-side guide on this site for both scientific accuracy and practical Maine-climate applicability.
